notes.title: Announcing new big project!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021355/624462e330cbb8ea2824b72f059a32b2fa1520b1.jpg[/img]

Did you like Courage for a Kiss? What about Summer Meetings?
Well, I'm sure you'll love this one.
This time, a few individuals get together to start a school newspaper. Will they succeed? Will they fall in love? Or something else will happen?

Lots of choices, several endings, interesting characters and more!

This is my biggest project so far, so I'm not sure when it will be finished, but I hope to make it before June 2020.

In the meantime, add the game to your wishlist and hit that follow button:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263110/

Best,
Mikołaj Spychał

notes.title: USAGIRI - Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021355/1eee45fc5e205ffee597b7cc36649fe4ff68bb13.png[/img]
Hello!
I'm happy to announce that USAGIRI, a spiritual successor to NEKOKORO is now available with a 30% off launch discount!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153950/USAGIRI/

And as previously, if you own all of my previous games, you can get an additional 20% on top of that:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/8186/Love__Comedy/

Let me know what you think! I'd appreciate all of your thoughts/opinions
If I notice that you enjoyed the game, I'll let you know if there will be sequel :)


So, what's next?
I'm working on my biggest project yet, something similar to Courage for a Kiss/Jake's Love Story/Summer Meetings. I once again went through all your reviews, let's plays and so on, so I hope to make something you'll love :)

Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!
Mikołaj Spychał

notes.title: USAGIRI - New game in progress
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021355/03ca8cee79be2dd56fbb3322fb6b218e48353095.png[/img]
Hi!
I'm very happy to announce what I'm working on next.
What do you think about cute girls with animal ears?
What's better than catgirls?
[h1]Bunny girls![/h1]
Become a patron - a person who takes care of them.
Yes, YOU! Set character name and gender if you wish.

The story will be linear this time, with one end. If you'll like it, there will be a continuation.

The game will be family-friendly, BUT... If I'll see high interest in this game, I'll finish working on Adult-Only DLC with interactive, animated scenes/minigames.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153950/USAGIRI/

I don't know when it will be finished as I have some personal stuff to take care of (final year of studies, writing Master's thesis, etc.), but I hope for the first quarter of 2020.

If you're wondering why not something from NEKOKORO universe:
Despite the positive feedback, the production costs were too high and I still don't see any profits from it. It's too risky to make a continuation of a failed project. But If this one does well enough to cover the costs of itself AND previous games, I'll get back to it.

Best,
Mikołaj Spychał
